items.title: Chrome Dev for Desktop Update

items.summary: Hi everyone! We've just released Chrome Dev 160 (160.0.8157.3) for Android. It's now available on Google Play . You can see a partial list of the changes in the Git log . For details on new features, check out the Chromium blog , and for details on web platform updates, check here . If you find a new issue, please let us know by filing a bug . Chrome Release Team Google Chrome
items.title: Chrome Dev for Android Update

items.summary: Hello Everyone! We've just released Chrome 158 (158.0.8127.36) for Android to a small percentage of users. It'll become available on Google Play over the next few days. You can find more details about early Stable releases here . This release includes stability and performance improvements. You can see a full list of the changes in the Git log . If you find a new issue, please let us know by filing a bug . Harry Souders Google Chrome
items.title: Chrome for Android Update

items.summary: The Stable channel has been updated to 158.0.8127.36/.37 for Windows , Mac will be coming shortly as part of our early stable release to a small percentage of users. A full list of changes in this build is available in the log . You can find more details about early Stable releases here . Interested in switching release channels?  Find out how here . If you find a new issue, please let us know by filing a bug . The community help forum is also a great place to reach out for help or learn about common issues. Srinivas Sista Google Chrome
items.title: Early Stable Update for Desktop

items.summary: The Chrome team is excited to announce the promotion of Chrome 159 to the Beta channel for Windows, Mac and Linux. Chrome 159.0.8154.6 contains our usual under-the-hood performance and stability tweaks, but there are also some cool new features to explore - please head to the Chromium blog to learn more! A partial list of changes is available in the Git log . Interested in switching release channels? Find out how . If you find a new issue, please let us know by filing a bug . The community help forum is also a great place to reach out for help or learn about common issues. Chrome Release Team Google Chrome
